","active":true,"version":1},{"uid":"travel-455","id":455,"number":455,"category":"Travel Skills","sourceNumber":121,"title":"","description":"","tags":[],"image":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","active":true,"version":1}]</script>
<script>
/*
  MOTOR CITY HOCKEY - SINGLE FRONT-END APP
  -------------------------------------------------------
  Production security mode:
  - Set API_BASE to your protected drill API.
  - The API should return only search/browse results, not a master PDF.
  - The export endpoint should accept selected drill UIDs and return a PDF containing only those drills.
  - This demo package uses local seed data so it works immediately.
*/
const MCH_CONFIG = {
  API_BASE: '',
  IMAGE_BASE_URL: '',
  USE_SERVER_EXPORT: false,
  categories: ['Travel Skills','6U / 8U','Learn to Play','Team Drills','Off-Ice Drills','Small Area Games']
};
const seed = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('mchSeedData').textContent);
let database = seed.map(d => ({...d, image: MCH_CONFIG.IMAGE_BASE_URL ? MCH_CONFIG.IMAGE_BASE_URL.replace(/\/$/,'')+'/'+d.image.replace(/^assets\//,'assets/') : d.image}));

// Database is embedded in this file; no separate JSON request is required.
window.MCH_DATABASE_READY = database.length > 0;\nwindow.MCH_DATABASE_COUNT = database.length;
let selected = [];
let activeCategory = 'Travel Skills';
let exportFormat = 'landscape';
let selectedSortable = null;

const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
const $$ = s => [...document.querySelectorAll(s)];
const esc = s => String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,m=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[m]));
function toast(msg){const t=$('#toast');t.textContent=msg;t.classList.add('show');setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),1700)}
function saveSet(){localStorage.setItem('mch-practice-set-v3',JSON.stringify(selected.map(d=>d.uid)))}
function restoreSet(){try{const uids=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('mch-practice-set-v3')||'[]');selected=uids.map(u=>database.find(d=>d.uid===u)).filter(Boolean)}catch(e){selected=[]}}
function isSelected(uid){return selected.some(d=>d.uid===uid)}
function addDrill(d){if(!d)return;if(isSelected(d.uid)){toast('Drill already in your set');return}selected.push(d);saveSet();renderSelected();renderGrid();toast(`Added Drill ${d.number}`)}
function removeDrill(uid){selected=selected.filter(d=>d.uid!==uid);saveSet();renderSelected();renderGrid()}
function moveDrill(uid,dir){const i=selected.findIndex(d=>d.uid===uid);const j=i+dir;if(i<0||j<0||j>=selected.length)return;[selected[i],selected[j]]=[selected[j],selected[i]];saveSet();renderSelected()}

function renderSelected(){
  $('#selectedCount').textContent=selected.length;
  const strip=$('#selectedStrip');
  if(!selected.length){strip.innerHTML='<div class="selected-empty">Add drills below. Your selected drills stay pinned here and can be reordered.</div>';return}
  strip.innerHTML=selected.map((d,i)=>`<div class="sel-card" draggable="true" data-uid="${esc(d.uid)}">
    <span class="sel-order">${i+1}</span><button class="sel-remove" data-remove="${esc(d.uid)}">×</button>
    <img src="${esc(d.image)}" alt="Drill ${esc(d.number)}" loading="lazy"/>
    <div class="sel-meta"><div class="sel-number">#${esc(d.number)} ${esc(d.title||'')}</div><div class="sel-book">${esc(d.category)}</div></div>
    <div class="sel-move"><button data-left="${esc(d.uid)}">◀</button><button data-right="${esc(d.uid)}">▶</button></div>
  </div>`).join('');
  strip.querySelectorAll('[data-remove]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=e=>{e.stopPropagation();removeDrill(b.dataset.remove)});
  strip.querySelectorAll('[data-left]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=e=>{e.stopPropagation();moveDrill(b.dataset.left,-1)});
  strip.querySelectorAll('[data-right]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=e=>{e.stopPropagation();moveDrill(b.dataset.right,1)});
  let dragUid=null;
  strip.querySelectorAll('.sel-card').forEach(card=>{
    card.addEventListener('dragstart',()=>{dragUid=card.dataset.uid;card.classList.add('dragging')});
    card.addEventListener('dragend',()=>card.classList.remove('dragging'));
    card.addEventListener('dragover',e=>e.preventDefault());
    card.addEventListener('drop',e=>{e.preventDefault();const target=card.dataset.uid;if(!dragUid||dragUid===target)return;const from=selected.findIndex(d=>d.uid===dragUid);const to=selected.findIndex(d=>d.uid===target);const [item]=selected.splice(from,1);selected.splice(to,0,item);saveSet();renderSelected()});
  });

  if(window.Sortable){
    if(selectedSortable) selectedSortable.destroy();
    selectedSortable = new Sortable(strip,{animation:160,direction:'horizontal',delay:100,delayOnTouchOnly:true,touchStartThreshold:4,onEnd:()=>{
      const order=[...strip.querySelectorAll('.sel-card')].map(el=>el.dataset.uid);
      selected=order.map(uid=>selected.find(d=>d.uid===uid)).filter(Boolean);saveSet();renderSelected();
    }});
  }
}
function populateQuick(){
  $('#quickCategory').innerHTML=MCH_CONFIG.categories.map(c=>`<option>${esc(c)}</option>`).join('');
  $('#quickCategory').value=activeCategory;
}
function renderCategories(){
  $('#categoryTabs').innerHTML=MCH_CONFIG.categories.map(c=>{const n=database.filter(d=>d.category===c).length;return `<button class="cat ${c===activeCategory?'active':''}" data-cat="${esc(c)}">${esc(c)} <span class="mini-count">${n}</span></button>`}).join('');
  $$('.cat').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{activeCategory=b.dataset.cat;renderCategories();renderFilters();renderGrid()});
}
function renderFilters(){
  const f=$('#sortFilter');
  if(!f.value) f.value='number';
}
function filteredData(){
  const q=$('#searchBox').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  let rows=database.filter(d=>d.category===activeCategory);
  if(q) rows=rows.filter(d=>[d.number,d.title,d.description,(d.tags||[]).join(' ')].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(q));
  if($('#sortFilter').value==='title') rows.sort((a,b)=>(a.title||'').localeCompare(b.title||'')||Number(a.number)-Number(b.number));
  else rows.sort((a,b)=>Number(a.number)-Number(b.number));
  return rows;
}
function renderGrid(){
  const rows=filteredData();$('#resultHint').textContent=`${rows.length} drills shown`;
  const grid=$('#drillGrid');
  if(!rows.length){const future=database.filter(d=>d.category===activeCategory).length===0;grid.innerHTML=`<div class="empty-library"><b>${esc(activeCategory)}</b><br>${future?'Database is ready for you to add this category.':'No drills match your filters.'}</div>`;return}
  grid.innerHTML=rows.map(d=>`<article class="drill-card ${isSelected(d.uid)?'selected':''}" data-uid="${esc(d.uid)}">
    <span class="add-chip">${isSelected(d.uid)?'✓':'+'}</span><img src="${esc(d.image)}" alt="Drill ${esc(d.number)}" loading="lazy" onerror="this.style.opacity=.18;this.alt='Image loading error'"/>
    <div class="drill-n">Drill ${esc(d.number)}</div><div class="drill-title">${esc(d.title||'')}</div><div class="drill-desc">${esc(d.description||'Description can be added later without changing the drill number.')}</div>
  </article>`).join('');
  grid.querySelectorAll('.drill-card').forEach(card=>card.onclick=()=>{const d=database.find(x=>x.uid===card.dataset.uid);isSelected(d.uid)?removeDrill(d.uid):addDrill(d)});
}

$('#quickCategory').onchange=()=>{activeCategory=$('#quickCategory').value;renderCategories();renderFilters();renderGrid()};
$('#quickAddBtn').onclick=()=>{
  const c=$('#quickCategory').value;
  const n=$('#quickNumber').value.trim();
  if(!n){toast('Enter a drill number');return}
  const match=database.find(d=>d.category===c && String(d.number)===String(n));
  if(match){addDrill(match);$('#quickNumber').value='';}
  else toast('No matching drill found in this category');
};
$('#quickNumber').addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')$('#quickAddBtn').click()});
$('#searchBox').oninput=renderGrid;$('#sortFilter').onchange=renderGrid;
$('#clearSetBtn').onclick=()=>{if(selected.length&&confirm('Clear your current practice set?')){selected=[];saveSet();renderSelected();renderGrid()}};
$('#exportBtn').onclick=()=>{if(!selected.length){toast('Add at least one drill first');return}$('#exportModal').classList.add('open')};
$('#closeExportBtn').onclick=()=>$('#exportModal').classList.remove('open');
$('#exportModal').onclick=e=>{if(e.target.id==='exportModal')$('#exportModal').classList.remove('open')};
$$('#formatSeg button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{exportFormat=b.dataset.format;$$('#formatSeg button').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',x===b));const phone=exportFormat==='phone';$('#densitySelect').disabled=phone;$('#exportNote').innerHTML=phone?'<b>Phone / On-Ice:</b> one large drill per phone-sized PDF page so coaches can view it on the ice without pinching and zooming.':`<b>${exportFormat[0].toUpperCase()+exportFormat.slice(1)}:</b> 8 drills per Letter page by default. There is no limit on selected drills; the PDF simply adds pages.`});

async function imageData(url){
  if(/^data:image\//i.test(String(url||''))) return url;
  const res=await fetch(url,{cache:'force-cache'});
  if(!res.ok)throw new Error('image');
  const blob=await res.blob();
  return await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
    const r=new FileReader();
    r.onload=()=>resolve(r.result);
    r.onerror=reject;
    r.readAsDataURL(blob);
  });
}
function safeText(s,n=70){s=String(s||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();return s.length>n?s.slice(0,n-1)+'…':s}
async function generatePdf(){
  if(!selected.length)return;
  if(MCH_CONFIG.USE_SERVER_EXPORT && MCH_CONFIG.API_BASE){toast('Server export mode is configured for deployment.');return}
  if(!window.jspdf){toast('PDF library did not load - use Print View instead');return}
  const {jsPDF}=window.jspdf;const density=Number($('#densitySelect').value||8);let doc,cols,rows,pageW,pageH,margin=20,gap=7;
  if(exportFormat==='phone'){doc=new jsPDF({orientation:'portrait',unit:'pt',format:[306,540]});cols=1;rows=1;margin=14;gap=0}
  else if(exportFormat==='landscape'){doc=new jsPDF({orientation:'landscape',unit:'pt',format:'letter'});cols=density===12?4:4;rows=density===12?3:2}
  else{doc=new jsPDF({orientation:'portrait',unit:'pt',format:'letter'});cols=density===12?3:2;rows=4}
  pageW=doc.internal.pageSize.getWidth();pageH=doc.internal.pageSize.getHeight();const perPage=cols*rows;const header=exportFormat==='phone'?26:28;const cellW=(pageW-margin*2-gap*(cols-1))/cols;const cellH=(pageH-margin*2-header-gap*(rows-1))/rows;
  for(let i=0;i<selected.length;i++){
    if(i>0 && i%perPage===0)doc.addPage();const pos=i%perPage;const r=Math.floor(pos/cols),c=pos%cols;const x=margin+c*(cellW+gap),y=margin+header+r*(cellH+gap);const d=selected[i];
    doc.setDrawColor(205);doc.roundedRect(x,y,cellW,cellH,5,5);doc.setFillColor(215,25,32);doc.circle(x+13,y+13,10,'F');doc.setTextColor(255);doc.setFont('helvetica','bold');doc.setFontSize(8);doc.text(String(i+1),x+13,y+16,{align:'center'});doc.setTextColor(20);doc.setFontSize(exportFormat==='phone'?12:8.5);doc.text(`Drill ${d.number}`,x+27,y+16);if(d.title){doc.setFont('helvetica','normal');doc.setFontSize(7);doc.text(safeText(d.title,34),x+27,y+27)}
    try{const data=await imageData(d.image);const props=doc.getImageProperties(data);const topPad=exportFormat==='phone'?34:30;const bottomPad=d.description?18:7;const maxW=cellW-10,maxH=cellH-topPad-bottomPad;const scale=Math.min(maxW/props.width,maxH/props.height);const iw=props.width*scale,ih=props.height*scale;doc.addImage(data,'JPEG',x+(cellW-iw)/2,y+topPad,iw,ih,undefined,'FAST')}catch(e){doc.setFontSize(7);doc.text('Image unavailable',x+8,y+45)}
    if(d.description){doc.setFont('helvetica','normal');doc.setFontSize(exportFormat==='phone'?9:6.5);doc.setTextColor(75);doc.text(safeText(d.description,exportFormat==='phone'?90:62),x+7,y+cellH-6,{maxWidth:cellW-14})}
  }
  const name=($('#fileName').value||'MCH-Practice-Set').replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]+/gi,'-');doc.save(name+'.pdf');toast('PDF created')
}
$('#generatePdfBtn').onclick=generatePdf;
$('#printFallbackBtn').onclick=()=>{const w=window.open('','_blank');const cards=selected.map((d,i)=>`<div class="p"><div class="pn">${i+1}. Drill ${esc(d.number)}</div><img src="${esc(d.image)}"><div class="pd">${esc(d.description||'')}</div></div>`).join('');w.document.write(`<html><head><title>MCH Practice Set</title><style>@page{size:${exportFormat==='landscape'?'letter landscape':'letter portrait'};margin:.25in}body{font-family:Arial}.g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:${exportFormat==='landscape'?'repeat(4,1fr)':'repeat(2,1fr)'};gap:8px}.p{break-inside:avoid;border:1px solid #aaa;padding:6px}.p img{width:100%;height:2.25in;object-fit:contain}.pn{font-weight:bold}.pd{font-size:9px}</style></head><body><div class="g">${cards}</div><script>setTimeout(()=>print(),400)<\/script></body></html>`);w.document.close()};

restoreSet();populateQuick();renderCategories();renderFilters();renderSelected();renderGrid();
</script>
</body></html>
